verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies necessary electrical load calculations as an acceptance condition for the permit-ready electrical drawings; the recorded project kickoff timing is correctly excluded.
The freelancer identifies a material unresolved conflict over whether the deliverable includes producing calculations rather than only reviewing and stamping existing work.

The client broadens and clarifies the executable deliverable from necessary load calculations to whatever electrical calculations are required to produce the electrical drawings; overwriting the existing scope key leaves no stale attribute.
The client resolves the calculation-deliverable uncertainty, returning the clarified electrical-calculation obligation to active status.
